finding.mechanism: suvm_rp1 drives su8 start and the vm8q PROG read (p_re/p_idx) from the SAME su_cmd edge (comment: "Start and program request use the SAME landed su_cmd source"). su8_rst3 accepts its program word (acc_k -> fa <= c_si) at su_cmd+5; the vm8q_rp1 PROG word reaches su8 c_si only at su_cmd+8 (relay 1 + s8x_prog pp/SRAM/pcap/p_q 4 + u_rapg 1 + u_opg 1 + su8 pin kff 1). su8 latches the stale si (0 at power-up: nout 0 / nin 0) and stays busy forever (su_idle 0, prog 0, rows 0, no fault). The 10-21 su8 bind packet (results/rtl/qwen_slice_su8_bind_1021) already priced PROG +2 (P2) / unchanged (P3) "to be composed in the static calendar", but no calendar can absorb it: start and PROG read come from one command. No functional bench of the s8 parent existed (LP lockstep vs its own lagref only).
